correctness.rationale: In the radius-two 24-cell V consists of 8 axial points ±2e_i and 16 sign vectors (±1,±1,±1,±1), giving 24 Euclidean vertices. Independent implementation generated W(F4) order 1152 from coordinate swaps, sign inversion and H/2; checked vertex metric preservation. Enumerated all 42,504 unordered 5-subsets, computed orbits and lexicographically minimized ten squared edge lengths over 120 internal permutations; found exactly 81 disjoint orbits covering every set with 81 distinct canonical distance signatures. At each representative, independently enumerated intrinsic metric automorphisms and W(F4) restrictions from its set stabilizer, finding exact equality in all 81. Hence each specified isometry A→B extends: choose global g sending the sets, then extend internal g^{-1}f from the stabilizer. Independent orbit size spectrum {48:2,72:1,96:4,144:4,192:4,288:15,576:39,1152:12}; 49 affine independent and 32 dependent orbits, consistent with original source. Finite exhaustive computation is a finite proof only because all classes and stabilizers are enumerated with exact integers; it does not generalize to arbitrary larger sets.
